title: The Private Confession (first full midpoint attempt)

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri walks with you until the noise of the court is behind a hedge.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The Royal Gardens are so quiet you can hear the fountain hiccup.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Congratulations. You’ve been granted my exclusive, invitation-only silence. Reviews are mixed.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Please don’t. I’ve been clapped at enough for one lifetime.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She sits on the edge of the fountain. Her tail, which never stops, stops.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Do you know what happens when you’re the funny princess?”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Nobody asks if you’re all right. They ask when you’ll be funny again.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “It’s comfortable, as long as you never stop.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I can make a whole court laugh. I once made a tax collector laugh. During an audit.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “And I don’t know if anyone would stay if I ran out of clever things to say.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She waits for the joke that usually comes next. It doesn’t come.

options.labelText: “Can I tell you something? I hide behind being useful.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Before I came here, I got turned down for job after job. I kept thinking that if I was useful enough, I’d finally earn a place.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “When I’m not succeeding at something, I don’t know who I am.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “But I’d sit here with you even if neither of us said anything clever.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “You? You explain disasters as tidy little lists.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “The lists are how you know I’m panicking.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “That’s an alarming amount of honesty for one fountain.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “We can stop.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “No. I want to try something.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I had a miserable day.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Nothing sparkles after it. She looks startled that she let the sentence out unsupervised.

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I’m sorry. Want to tell me about it?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Only if you promise not to file a quarterly report on my feelings.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tells you about it. None of it is funny.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Somewhere around the part with the soup, her tail starts moving again.

options.labelText: “That’s ridiculous. Everyone adores you. You’re the funniest person in the kingdom.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Yes. That’s the part I’m worried about.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I meant it kindly.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Oh, I know you did.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Anyway! Have I told you about the duke and the soup?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Her tail is moving again, a little too fast.

options.labelText: “Then we make sure you never run out. I’ll help you write new material.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I asked if you’d stay when the jokes run out. You offered to improve the show.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “That wasn’t what you were asking.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “No.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She stands, brushes herself off, and is charming all the way back past the hedge.
